criteria.description: Anthropic AgentModelClient serializes system/messages/tools/tool_choice to /v1/messages and parses text plus tool_use responses.
assistant.agentic.provider supports anthropic without enabling agentic by default.
audited is the default permission posture and allows low-risk scoped mutations while asking on high-risk arg upgrades.
readonly/emergency modes fail closed for mutations.
Prompt hook evaluator calls the model with hook prompt and event payload; mcp-tool hook caller invokes only read-only sync MCP tools.
Frontend renders tool calls, async waits, subagent runs, tool observations, and agentic phase timeline while preserving action approval.
tests: assistant-components.test.js: renders agentic tool calls, async waits, subagents, and phase timeline
assistant-components.test.js: renders agentic action approval and publishes action decisions
